metadata.description: ThisIsEnough — requirement sync and lightweight file-first workflow runtime for coding agents

plugins.name: tie
plugins.description: ThisIsEnough — lightweight file-first workflow that keeps the user's mental model, the agent's understanding, and the codebase in sync. A user-approved checklist gates implementation, a committed ARCHITECTURE.md (constitution + map) replaces per-session codebase re-scanning, and each run is five files driven through plan, implement, verify, and fix loops.
